You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module defines a very small state machine with a single variable x. It introduces a higher-order helper operator Op that filters a set S using two operator arguments, requiring both P(s) and Q(s, TRUE) for membership. The initial condition constrains x to belong to the filtered subset of {1,2,3,4,5} consisting of elements greater than 1 and odd, and the only step relation is stuttering because Next is defined as UNCHANGED x. There are no explicit temporal properties, fairness assumptions, proofs, or fault model annotations in the file.
